title: One Quick Test
premise: Alex tests a new model with a backflipping cube while his checkout stays broken.

scenes.description: Alex clicks Pay. Checkout fails and a model alert interrupts.
scenes.label: checkout

scenes.description: The alert expands into the launch chart. Alex clicks Try.
scenes.label: chart

scenes.anchor: Make a cube do a backflip.
scenes.description: Astra arrives as Alex types. The cube flips and sticks the landing.
scenes.label: cube

scenes.description: Alex points out Pay. The keyboard changes hands and the cart is redesigned.
scenes.label: rebuild

scenes.description: Alex asks if checkout works. Pay repeats the cube’s backflip and shows “Payment failed” as Astra praises the trick.
scenes.label: pay

scenes.description: A new model alert covers the failed checkout. Alex clicks Try on its arrival.
scenes.label: again
